summary: This note describes Nefteyugansky District, an administrative and municipal district (raion) in Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug, Russia. It is one of nine raions in the okrug and lies in its south. Its administrative center is the city of Nefteyugansk, which is not administratively part of the district.
one_line: Nefteyugansky District is a raion in the south of Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug, Russia, centered on Nefteyugansk.
key_facts: Nefteyugansky District is an administrative and municipal district (raion) in Russia.
Nefteyugansky District is one of the nine raions in Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug.
Nefteyugansky District is located in the south of Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug.
The administrative center of Nefteyugansky District is the city of Nefteyugansk.
Nefteyugansk is not administratively a part of Nefteyugansky District.
The population of Nefteyugansky District was 44,815 at the 2010 Census.
